status: Local exploratory power and phase-correlation comparison; noisy observed reference

settings.window: Separable Tukey alpha=0.5; subtract each image own weighted mean before FFT; FFT divided by sqrt(sum(window**2)). Same window for every model and JWST.
settings.power: Geometric mean over objects of P_model/P_observed_JWST (mean log10 ratio); ideal 1. No image flux fitting, PSF correction or noise subtraction.
settings.correlation: Mean over objects of real cross-spectrum / sqrt(P_model*P_observed_JWST), each annularly averaged first. Signed, phase-sensitive r; ideal 1. Not magnitude-squared coherence.
